summary: Gate commit strict plays on a frozen raw CPU ceiling and retain independent wall and steal telemetry

replay.detail: CI harness only. A separate test-fixture correction passes undefined CPU counters explicitly instead of silently replacing them with default zero.

rules.detail: No product rule or case-set changes.

compatibility.detail: Commit receipts add CPU seconds, anchor and derived ceiling, plus raw CPU core-minutes, wall seconds and Linux proc/stat deltas including steal. Existing maxSeconds remains the wall guard value and overBudget is true when either CPU or wall fails. The single 413.9-second CPU anchor allows exactly 10% headroom. KIT_PLAY_WALL_GUARD_SECONDS replaces KIT_PLAY_MAX_SECONDS as an independent wall hang ceiling. Experimental normalization and calibration are removed.

manual.detail: After PR #3982 lands, lower the CPU anchor once to the new measured cost; never raise it later.
